items.title: The de Rham complex of a blowup splits off the de Rham complex of the base

items.difficulty_reason: The proposition shows that the de Rham complex of a blowup admits the de Rham complex of the base as a direct summand, a splitting statement that is one of the structural inputs to the de Rham theory of blowups (statement lines 3187-3192). The proof reduces to exhibiting a section of a map between the two summands of the blowup triangle, decomposes the situation into pieces of fixed relative dimension so that the projective bundle formula for the exceptional divisor applies, produces the isomorphism $\tilde\xi$ together with the subcomplexes $M$ and $K$, and then constructs the section explicitly out of the Gysin-type map $\delta$ whose composite with restriction is the Chern class map. The construction and verification of the explicit section is the substance, so the claim is H3.
